title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. This question is about payment of Mahr. A Muslim lady was divorced about 40 years back. Husband did not pay the Mahr to her. Now the husband wants to pay the Mahr to her. Please answer following question about this: 1. Is it correct for the lady to accept the Mahr amount from a husband who divorced her long back? 2. Is it mandatory for her to accept the Mahr amount? Will she commit any sin if she refuses to take the money and also do not forgive him? 3. Suppose that Mahr Amount was Rs. 1000/-. Ideally, husband should have paid it 40 years back. Suppose that prices have gone up 100 times since then. If the man is offering to pay her Rs. 1000 * 100 = Rs. 100000/-, is it correct for her to accept this much amount? 2425 views Q. What says Uluma-e-Karam in the light of Quran-o-Sunnah: There is a practice in our area according to which Nikah is done in proper Islamic way at the time of engagement but at the time of rukhsati, again Nikah is done in the same way. Uluma doing so admit the fact that once Nikah is done at the time of engagement, it is not necessary to repeat it at the time of rukhsati however they says it is better to repeat it ( or renew it ) at the time of rukhsati. It is necessary to mention here that it is an integaral part of the marriage ceremony in our area to arrange a function of doing nikah on the evening of Shabe-uroosi in which all close relatives participate. So if this function is not done, there would be confusion in the mind of relatives. My question is: ? whether this practice of repeating nikah is according to Quran-o-Sunnah and is there any evidence available in Sunnah. ? Is there any Hadees proving that this practice is forbidden. ? Then in case there is no evidence available in Sunah regarding allowing or disallowing, whether one can be allowed to repeat nikah for the sake of making people?s mind clear. 3765 views Q. Nikah and Mahr 3020 views Q. I want to know whether I can use protection covers when having sexual intercourse with my wife 6134 views Q. My question is regarding my cousin sister. Her nani and Ammi talk about her rishta with her khala's son in childhood. It was Ok for upto last 4 yrs. now the we heard that he, her khala's son who work in abroad having an affair/relation with 'gairmahram' woman. We not seen with our eyes, people who stays their they talk about him. My one of chaha, her Mamu and other relatives also stays their but no one says confidently about his relation. But other people always talk about his charecter. My sister is mashaAllah beautiful, well educated, follower of deen, hijab, very respectful and littlebit stubborn. And we heard so about her khala's son. My chachi(sister's Ammi) passes away four year back. From last three years my sister told that she dont want to marry with him (her khala's son). Upto this it was ok. Now she is interested to marry with him even she know the everything. All my family is apposing to this. When I asked my sister why u taking such dicision, that u r refussing from last three years(She didnt talk/kept relation with that boy(her khala's son) from last three years)She told I want to be in touch with my father in future. Her khala will understand her and there will be good co-ordination between them. And told give him a chance to be a good man. And if I marry someone else what guarntee that the fellow will be alright he will understand me. For her so many rishtey came she all refused. Now she/we are in very confussing mode that what can we do. What step we should take. Please suggest shall we accept this rishta because of her thinking. Try to reply on my mail id(let it be personal) Jazakumullah. 2950 views Q. can a sunni girl marry bohri boy,the boy insisting nikah to take place at thier jamat khana,is it permisable in hanfi sect? 6210 views Q. How much is alloed before Nikah? 3006 views Q. I am a sunni muslim of 28 yrs. Recently in april i married to a 27 yrs shia girl with out the consent of her parents. My parents are ready, but i am not sattisfied with the authentication of marriage certificate provided by the qazi at the time of nikkah. Moreover, i am working in saudi arabia, now i want to call my wife here but i am afraid of the authentication of certificate. What should i do that marriage certficate contains only the name and address of the qazi & not the name of any goverining body. if the authentication is fake what should I do to make it proper. kindly suggest. 2947 views Q. Is it correct to accept gift during marriage? If no, is it acceptable some one accept gift with intention of distributing to poor? 5069 views Q. Assalam o Alaikum, Question: I am in love with a girl for 6 years. She also loves me. Both of us want to marry each other but her father always refuses without giving any reason. Presently he wants to break our relationship but we have decided to perform Nikah immediately without the information & involvement of her family, because we can't live without each other. My Question are: 1) Can we marry/nikah each other without the involvement and information of her family members. Will that Nikah be Valid? 2) If her father gets aggreed after 2 years, will it be allowed for us to perform Nikah again in front of our families? Please give detailed answers because we are very disturbed. May ALLAH bless you with his countless blessings . 2822 views Q. Is it legal if yes then up till what limit... Please explain... Regards 24934 views Q. Assalam. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 36625 Country: India Title: I recently got married and came to Saudi Arabia. Once I heard from one of my Pakistani friend while having general discussion Question: I recently got married and came to Saudi Arabia. Once I heard from one of my Pakistani friend while having general discussion, suddenly he said husband cannot kiss or suck breast and nipple while having sex with his wife. Because Allah has already reserved that places for her Kids to feeding milk from their mother's breast by sucking nipples. Please give an answer in the light of the holy Quran and hadith, can husband kiss or suck breast and nipple of his wife even though wife has milk in her breast or empty of milk her breast. Please let me know is there any Islamic book in English or Hindi, how to have sex with wife and how to fulfill all kinds of rights for his wife. Answer ID: 36625 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 272/155/H=1433) (1) Though it is allowable but if milk goes in the mouth then it is haram to swallow it one should spit it out. And nikah shall remain intact as usual due to this act though one shall be sinful if swallows the milk. (2) Printed version of Bahishti Zewar is available in Hindi and English in the book stores. Buy it and read it thoroughly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
